detail.longDescription:
Rust is a bugger of a language sometimes. The learning curve is steep, and I still trip over lifetimes.

But there is a lot to be said for being able to spend an hour writing code, fixing the errors as they pop up in your editor, AND THEN doing cargo run… and it just works.

A fairly extensive refactor that just worked, because the compiler guided me to make something correct. I really appreciate it. Shout out to everyone that works on it.

#rustlang #programming
